# Vendored front-end assets

These files are checked in so the console works offline and never depends on a
third-party CDN at runtime.

| Asset | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HTMX (`htmx.min.js`) | 2.0.11 | BSD 2-Clause | https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx |
| Bootstrap (`bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`) | 5.3.8 | MIT | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap |
| Bootstrap Icons (`bootstrap-icons.min.css`, `fonts/*`) | 1.13.2 | MIT | https://github.com/twbs/icons |

The upstream license texts are available at the source links above. No
modifications were made beyond minification performed by the upstream
projects.
